controles.affirmation: Fermeture definitive de Joslin (IL) et Eagle Mountain (UT), poursuite de la vente de Pasco (WA), 2e equipe a Amarillo 'as cattle become available'
controles.verbatim_source: the Company will end operations at its beef facility in Joslin, Illinois and at its beef and pork case-ready facility in Eagle Mountain, Utah. In addition, the Company is pursuing the sale of its beef facility in Pasco, Washington. The Company plans to add a second shift at its beef facility in Amarillo, Texas as cattle become available. (8-K 13/08/2026, Item 7.01)

controles.affirmation: Clemence conditionnelle du DOJ obtenue en 2021 sur le volet penal poulet, valable tant que Tyson coopere avec l'enquete antitrust federale en cours
controles.verbatim_source: In August 2021, the Company was granted conditional leniency by the DOJ for the matters we self-reported, which means that provided the Company continues to cooperate with the DOJ, neither the Company nor any of our cooperating employees will face prosecution or criminal fines or penalties. We continue to cooperate with the DOJ in connection with the ongoing federal antitrust investigation.

controles.affirmation: Proces Track Two attendu en septembre 2027 ; Beef Antitrust : 55 M$ payes a la classe des acheteurs indirects en novembre 2025
controles.verbatim_source: The Court has entered a case schedule under which the first Track Two trial will begin in September 2027. ; On September 29, 2025, the Company reached an agreement with the consumer indirect purchaser plaintiff class to settle their claims in this matter for an aggregate of $55 million ... The Company paid the settlement on November 26, 2025.

controles.affirmation: Oklahoma : jugement de decembre 2025, accord du 10 juillet 2026, fonds environnemental d'environ 41,7 M$ dont environ 18 M$ a la charge de Tyson, plus environ 1,2 M$, sous reserve de vacatur judiciaire
controles.verbatim_source: On July 10, 2026, the Company and the other defendants entered into a settlement agreement with the State of Oklahoma ... The settlement provides for an environmental relief fund of approximately $41.7 million in the aggregate, of which the Company's obligation is approximately $18 million, as well as a contribution by the Company of approximately $0.2 million to a penalty fund and approximately $1 million to an auditor fund. Pursuant to the agreement, the parties will cooperate to seek vacatur of the December 19, 2025 judgment

controles.verbatim_source: The Beef segment continues to experience limited supply of market-ready cattle as well as increased cattle costs. Additionally, uncertainty exists regarding the timing of the cattle herd rebuilding.
